title: feat(samek6): nu same-k reverse holds at k=6 on B18; t(16,0,0) drops to 22
science: Extends the same-k sweep (#6775, k=1..5) by one scale on the larger host B_18(0) (8473 sites): t(6,0,0)=12, t(6,6,6)=20, so 432>400 and same-k reverse still holds at k=6. Also records another host-boundary shift of the axis arrival -- t(16,0,0) is 22 on B_18 versus 24 on B_16 -- which is the same wall effect that produced the k=6 face-reverse correction in #6769/#6772.
